correctness.rationale: For any v,L>0 and a>|b| >=0, the periodic two-state backward tilted generator gives a 2x2 monodromy of determinant 1. Its trace is exactly the hyperbolic expression in RESULT.md. The trace derivative with respect to the spectral parameter at zero is L^2 a/v^2>0; analytic inversion through fourth order yields psi(k)=v^2k^2/(2a)+[-v^4/(8a^3)+L^2b^2v^2/(96a^3)]k^4+O(k^6). Irreducibility for positive switching rates guarantees the leading spectral branch determines cumulant growth; differentiation proves the stated rates and exact sign boundary. Pure Python high-precision transfer equation comparisons give 24 numerical checks, not the all-parameter proof. Limits at the critical curve are stated only for leading asymptotic cumulants.

value.rationale: This resolves an experimentally meaningful non-Gaussian transport discriminator for a natural alternating two-material motility environment: a and v fix the exact Gaussian diffusion coefficient, while L and b can switch the long-time kurtosis-correction sign. The threshold L|b|=2sqrt(3)v is sharp, with both signs realizable at strictly positive hazards when aL>2sqrt(3)v. The fourth-cumulant coefficient is not determined by effective diffusivity, and the result is a complete phase boundary rather than a tiny parameter correction.
